status: registered before any R-ZOO training or evaluation
direction: Scalable benchmark: how language-readable are frozen EO foundation-model embeddings? (docs/NOVELTY_DIRECTIONS_20260927.md follow-up requested by the user: broader, scale-up-able)
task: Sen12 window embeddings (12 timesteps -> one spatial map per tile). Q: 'During the observed period, did a landslide occur in this area?' yes = mask >= 200 px, no = empty mask, 1-199 px dropped. Labels from olmo_nano/mask_u8 (identical tile set in all caches, checked 2026-09-27).

test_regions: china (29 / 78, never used by any EO-VLM run)

caveats: caches were built in August by different scripts (window/band/timestamp handling differs per encoder); differences mix encoder quality and cache contract
all maps pooled to 8x8 = 64 tokens; this favours coarse encoders less than fine ones
arms: per encoder: reader (LayerNorm-MLP projector + learned 64-token position, frozen Olmo-3-7B, 2 epochs, AdamW 1e-4, batch 8) seeds 1-3; head (LayerNorm-MLP on mean-pooled tokens, BCE, AdamW 1e-3, same epochs/batches) seeds 1-3; shared blind reader (zero input) seeds 1-3
evaluation: reader: real, swap_cross_tile (same test region, opposite answer), zero_embedding; head: same; blind: real. Greedy, max_new_tokens 8

primary_verdict_per_encoder.readable: >= 2 of 3 seeds with reader balanced_acc - blind balanced_acc >= 0.05 AND d_cross >= 0.10 with tile-bootstrap CI lower > 0

descriptive: size scaling within OlmoEarth (nano, tiny, base) and within Galileo (nano, tiny, base): mean reader BA and d_cross with seed range
reader - head BA per encoder ('LLM tax/gain')
per-region BA, especially china (untouched) and indonesia
encoder ranking with seed ranges (no significance claim across encoders in v0)
what_this_does_not_show: which pretraining objective causes readability (confounded with cache contract and size)
compute: our own GPUs only when no other user's process; part A (OlmoEarth x3, Galileo x3, blind) and part B (Prithvi, Clay x2) may run on different GPUs
